tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyan mchog dus mchod dpyad khra mkhan rin po che'i dbus phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun rnams la zhu gsol// nye lam nu bo rgyan mchog ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams mthu stobs dbang phyug bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid kyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib las ngan bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag nas sa lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur te slar yang 'khor ba ji srid bar de srid du rang re'i rje btsun gong ma'i bstan pa rin po che 'di la 'dzin skyong spel gsum bgyid pa'i mthu ldan sogs gang 'dul sprul pas rang gzhan la phan bde spel ba'i ched dam/ yang na de rang la chos 'brel thob pa'i slob bu rnams nas bla ma 'das pa'i dus mchod bsrung phyir gsang chen nying khu zab pa'i rtse bla ma'i rnal 'byor ram/ yang na rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gang rung zhig zhal phye nas de'i gtso bo dang dbyer med du sgrub cing mchod na tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs par yang dag pa'i lung dang / dngos stobs kyis rigs par grub pa bcas skabs su bab cing 'os su gyur pa ni rnal 'byor rgyud la rtsa bshad cha mthun gsum las slob dpon chen po kun dga' snying po'i lugs/ bod yul du gu ge lo chen gyi sku tshe'i stod la yo ga smad lugs dang / sku tshe'i smad la dharmā pā las kun snying gi lugs bskyar nas gsan de lo chen nyid sku na bgres shing bon po 'dul ba sogs kyi spros pa med pas/ kun rig sogs yo ga'i cho ga rnams la'ang tshig tshogs che ba dang / gdangs dbyangs sogs kyi spros pa bskyung nas dmar btus snying po lta bur mdzad cing sa cha stod du dar ba la yo ga stod lugs su grags pa las bshad ma thag pa de nyid kyi rjes su 'brang nas rje btsun rin po ches gzhan phan rnam gnyis mdzad cing / de'i dgongs 'grel ngor chen yab sras/

sa lo chen po rjes 'brangs dang bcas pas mdzad pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag gi gsal byed 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i kun rig sgrub dkyil cha lag dang bcas pa lhan cig tu bkod pa gzhan phan lhun grub sor bzhag mchod bsham spros bcas dang dam rgya/ las rgya gdangs dbyangs sogs phyag len rnam dag mdzes rgyan du bkod nas thugs dam nyams su bstar rgyu'i rim par/ mchod bshams rgyas pa ni/ ngor chen yab sras kyi gsung las/ dkyil 'khor gyi mthar chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod mtshams 'dzin bcas dang / de'i phyir sgos mchod spos/ me gzhan phyogs rer bco lnga re ste drug cu bshams pa ni/ rtsa lha so bdun la re re/ byang sems nyan rang dang / phyi'i sgo srung ba/ khor yug pa rnams la re re/ gtso bo'i zhal bzhi la re re yin par gsungs shing / mchod bum brgyad dam bcu drug dgos pa ni dngos gsal dang / zhar las 'ongs pa mchod pa nyer lnga'ang sngags rgya ting 'dzin gsum gyis 'bul ba ni bsdus pa'i lugs dang / rgyas pa ni sngags rgya ting 'dzin gsum gyis bsngo dgos pa las/ 'di lo gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan tsam las ma 'grig kyang slar nyer lnga sna bdun/ sna lnga bcas kyi gzugs gsar bzhengs thub tshe mchod rdzas su 'bul rtsis dang / cho ga'i rim pa'ang rgyas pa ltar na sa chog dngos sta bcas rdul tshon blugs la/ bdag bskyed bsnyen rgyas mchod 'phreng dang / bdag 'jug gi skad tshigs bcad sbyor ba sogs yin mod kyang / sa lo yab sras kyi phyag len la ma dar bas re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag nas da lta'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i kun rig sgrub mchod sor bzhag mdzad rgyu dang / nu bo de dge 'dun rnams kyi dbu blar song nas gsol 'debs mdzad pa shar tshe bstod ring rdzogs nas cha gsum gyi 'gor dpal ldan rtsa ba'i sogs shlau ka gcig 'gro la rjes brtse'i shlau ka dang po brgya tshar/ yongs rdzogs gdangs ma/

skye ba kun tu sogs/ dkon mchog gsum dngos nas/ snang ba stsal du gsol gyi bar ban tshang pa'i rgyun gyi bla mchod bzhin/ byang phyogs skyong ba'i sogs/ gangs can bod kyi sogs/ 'gro ba'i bla ma sogs dang / cho ga rjes mar gzhan gong bzhin la/ brgya tshar gyi rjes su gdung shugs mos gus kyi rang sgra gdangs ma bcas mdzad na ji ltar dang / gzhan dngos gzhi gong bkod bzhin 'gyur che smin grub/ 'das po de nyid kyi bsags sbyangs mchog tu 'gyur ba zhig 'di lo nas bzung 'dzugs bkod bgyid rgyu la chu stod tshes drug 'di nu bo de nyid gshin po phal pa ltar na bar do 'go zug gi dus dang / thugs dam pa ltar na 'od gsal zung 'jug tu langs pa'i dus yin pas/ 'di nyin 'das po de nyid rang gi lus srog longs spyod dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge tshogs mchod sprin rgya mtshor sprul nas/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi skyabs gnas thams cad mchod par mtshon pa'am/ yang na de rang gi slob bu 'brel thogs dang bcas pa'i dge tshogs mchod sprin rgya mtsho/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam snang chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ de'i sprul pa yang sprul bde bar gshegs pa sras dang slob mar bcas pa'i spyan lam du bstar ba mtshon byed sngon byon gong ma'i phyag srol sa skor mchod phreng can mdzad rgyu dang / grol nyin tshong dpon gyis 'khor gsum yongs dag gsung bsngo'i rgyas 'debs bcas mdor na 'di bskor tshang ma sde bstan pa gdung rgyud dang bcas pa'i mig rgyan la phan pa zhig 'dus tshogs su tshugs nyin zhu 'dun che yang / 'phral yun gyi rnam g.yeng du mas de nyin stabs ma 'grig rung / don gyi ngo bo sgrub mchod kyi skabs zhu thub pa zhig byung tshe snga rting la dbyer ma mchis pas de bzhin tshangs mas dgongs 'jags zhu// //zhes dpal sa skya pa ngag dga' kun dga' blo gros kyis gzhi thog bla brang nas sa stag chu stod zla bar bris//
